fleet.default_max_instances: 128,000 MB (Guangzhou/Shanghai/Beijing/Chengdu/HK) or 64,000 MB (Singapore/Tokyo/Silicon Valley/Frankfurt) of memory per region
fleet.notes: Concurrency is region-scoped aggregate memory: official guide gives 128,000 MB or 64,000 MB, not a universal function-instance count. E.g. 1,000 instances at 128 MB in a 128,000 MB region. Increases requested through console/support; function reservations and burst ramp are separate.
